flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (message-sent route commented out), pages/ManageTemplate/form/EditTemplateForm.tsx and CreateTemplateForm.tsx (Preview commented out), pages/Furnish/components/SelectTemplate.tsx (render for furnish). ocmsadminapi: crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsTemplateStore/OcmsTemplateStoreController (templatestore/render, requires noticeNo). No ad-hoc message preview screen
note: The story asks for a message preview after input or CSV upload, with an option to test send the first message or confirm sending. There is no ad-hoc preview screen on main: the PreviewTemplate and MessageList components exist only in git history (commit 07aba128), and the Preview button in EditTemplateForm and CreateTemplateForm is commented out (EditTemplateForm.tsx:55-66, CreateTemplateForm.tsx:48-56). The templatestore/render endpoint (OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:176-190) renders a template for one notice and requires noticeNo (:185-187); it is used by furnish (SelectTemplate.tsx:72), not an ad-hoc preview, so it is not counted. No relevant maintenance ticket (OCMS-DF-2026-136 is about the furnish template dropdown).
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The ad-hoc preview screen is not on main

steps.step: The single input or uploaded CSV is ready for preview
steps.detail: There is no ad-hoc input to pass on: the single form and CSV upload are not on main (see OCMS37.2 and OCMS37.3). Folder ocmsadminui/src/pages/epic37 (ComposeEmail, ComposeSMS, Upload, MessageSent) was deleted from main in commit 07aba128 (15 Apr 2025, git history, not evidence of running code); the Epic37 import at App.tsx:56 and the 6 compose/upload/message-sent routes at App.tsx:259-269 are now commented out, and the Compose Email/SMS/Message Sent menu entries at LinkData.tsx:143-156 are commented out too.

steps.step: A preview of the messages to be sent is shown
steps.detail: There is no ad-hoc message preview screen. The message-sent route is commented out (App.tsx:269); the Preview button in EditTemplateForm.tsx:55-66 is commented out too. PreviewTemplate.tsx exists only in git history (commit 07aba128).

steps.step: The preview shows recipient, subject and body of each message
steps.detail: The only render available is templatestore/render (OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:176-190) for one notice and it requires noticeNo (:185-187), used by furnish (SelectTemplate.tsx:72). It carries no recipient and is not an ad-hoc message list preview.

steps.step: From the preview the officer can choose test send or confirm
steps.detail: There is no test send/confirm button or action because the preview screen does not exist. No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc).
